evidence: The physical thickness of the films was determined by cross-sectional high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM). The chemical composition and physical characteristics of the as-deposited HfO2 film were analyzed by x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) and medium energy ion scattering measurement (MEIS). The capacitance-voltage (C-V) characteristics of the HfO2 MOS capacitors were measured by the Keithley 590 analyzer.
